title: Block volume
description: Defines a 3D volume of blocks in the world using a layered ASCII-art style format. Each character in the pattern maps to a block type through a key lookup, enabling efficient representation of structures like buildings, obstacles, or test arenas.

southWestBottom.title: South West Bottom of the volume

defaultSnippets.label: Vector3
defaultSnippets.description: A 3D coordinate (x, y, z) representing a position or direction in the Minecraft world. Y is the vertical axis (up/down), while X and Z form the horizontal plane. Used for specifying locations, offsets, and movement directions.
